patterns.working_title: Declare or initialise general scalar/array storage
patterns.boundary: General arrays/scalars, fixed supplied data; use specific ADT setup for stack/queue/list/tree/hash.

patterns.working_title: Declare a record-like field structure
patterns.boundary: QP asks for TYPE/record fields, allowing a class as a language substitute. If QP explicitly asks for an OOP class and constructor, use OOP_CLASS regardless of visibility or class name.

patterns.working_title: Append a record/value to bounded array storage
patterns.boundary: Check capacity, write next slot, update count; distinct from ordered insertion and ADT enqueue.

patterns.working_title: Insert into an already ordered table
patterns.boundary: Shift/position a new score or record in sorted storage; not sorting the whole input.

patterns.working_title: Generate random array data
patterns.boundary: Populate array with random values; uniqueness, bounds and dimensionality are variants.

patterns.working_title: Read text into arrays/records or an ADT
patterns.boundary: Read/parse lines, populate a data structure; invoked ADT operations belong to context unless implemented in this row.

patterns.working_title: Read data and construct or update objects
patterns.boundary: Construct object records, dispatch subclasses or locate/update existing objects from file records.

patterns.working_title: Write or append data to a text file
patterns.boundary: Output file records and stated error handling; read/write modes and provided/new file differ.

patterns.working_title: Find an element by sequential search
patterns.boundary: Return existence/index/match, possibly retry input; frequency uses COUNT_OCCURRENCES.

patterns.working_title: Count matching data items
patterns.boundary: Count repeated matches, characters or values; iterative/recursive implementation is a variant.

patterns.working_title: Select all records/objects satisfying conditions
patterns.boundary: Multiple conditions, case rules and reporting matches; not a single-key search.

patterns.working_title: Group repeated keys and update per-key totals
patterns.boundary: Find existing group or create one and accumulate its count/value.

patterns.working_title: Implement bubble sorting
patterns.boundary: Sort via adjacent comparisons/swaps; direction, dimensions, key order and comparator are variants.

patterns.working_title: Implement insertion sorting
patterns.boundary: Grow ordered prefix by extracting and shifting; recursive/iterative and record-key variants.

patterns.working_title: Search a sorted array by interval reduction
patterns.boundary: Iterative/recursive variants, bounds, midpoint and sentinel; tree search is TREE_SEARCH.

patterns.working_title: Declare or initialise stack state
patterns.boundary: Array capacity, values and top convention; general record declarations may be separate.

patterns.working_title: Implement push
patterns.boundary: Capacity test, pointer/index convention, write and result.

patterns.working_title: Implement pop
patterns.boundary: Empty case, read and pointer update; exact sentinel/type is a variant.

patterns.working_title: Coordinate two stacks with restoration
patterns.boundary: Pop paired items and restore the unmatched one when the other stack is empty.

patterns.working_title: Consume stack values to compute a result
patterns.boundary: Repeated pop with arithmetic/min/max; not merely calling Pop twice.

patterns.working_title: Declare or initialise queue state
patterns.boundary: Linear/circular, array/record wrapper, head/tail/count conventions.

patterns.working_title: Implement enqueue
patterns.boundary: Full handling and queue pointer/count updates, including wrap when specified.

patterns.working_title: Implement dequeue
patterns.boundary: Empty handling, read and pointer/count updates, preserving stored slots when required.

patterns.working_title: Read current queue contents without removing items
patterns.boundary: Follow live range for concatenation/output; not physical whole-array display or dequeue.

patterns.working_title: Consume or recursively process queue data
patterns.boundary: Accumulate/process queue values; group-by and RLE also have their own assessed tags where implemented.

patterns.working_title: Initialise linked-list and free-list storage
patterns.boundary: Record/2D array or object linked representation, head/free links and null conventions.

patterns.working_title: Follow linked-list links to output data
patterns.boundary: Logical list order, not physical array order.

patterns.working_title: Insert a linked-list node
patterns.boundary: Head/tail position, free-list allocation/object creation and link updates are variants.

patterns.working_title: Remove a linked-list node
patterns.boundary: First occurrence, head/middle/tail cases, presence assumptions and free-list recycling.

patterns.working_title: Initialise binary-tree storage
patterns.boundary: Array-backed nodes/root/free pointer or object tree wrapper; OOP constructor can be co-assessed.

patterns.working_title: Insert a node in a binary search tree
patterns.boundary: Search insertion position and update links/pointers with stated equal-key/full rules.

patterns.working_title: Search a binary search tree
patterns.boundary: Follow child pointers based on comparison; not sorted-array binary search.

patterns.working_title: Traverse a tree in a specified order
patterns.boundary: Inorder/postorder and representation/recursion variants; not physical array listing.

patterns.working_title: Initialise hash-table and collision storage
patterns.boundary: Bucket or spare-array representation and empty records.

patterns.working_title: Compute hash address
patterns.boundary: Apply specified key-to-address formula.

patterns.working_title: Insert a record with collision handling
patterns.boundary: Separate spare array versus fixed bucket as variants.

patterns.working_title: Retrieve a record using hash and collision storage
patterns.boundary: Compute address then check colliding records for matching key.

patterns.working_title: Declare class and constructor
patterns.boundary: Attributes, visibility, constructor parameters/defaults; OOP composition via object arrays is a variant.

patterns.working_title: Declare subclass and constructor
patterns.boundary: Inheritance, inherited/new attributes and parent constructor call.

patterns.working_title: Implement an accessor
patterns.boundary: Return stored attribute or indexed member; computed business results are RULE_COMPUTE.

patterns.working_title: Implement a direct setter
patterns.boundary: Replace an attribute with parameter; arithmetic/clamping update uses OOP_UPDATE.

patterns.working_title: Update object state according to a rule
patterns.boundary: Relative/percentage changes, movement, caps and multiple attributes.

patterns.working_title: Override inherited behaviour
patterns.boundary: Specialised method behavior and optional parent method call, not merely subclass declaration.

patterns.working_title: Construct instances from supplied or input data
patterns.boundary: Create and store named objects or object arrays; class definition separately assessed.

patterns.working_title: Add an object to a capacity-limited aggregate
patterns.boundary: For example station platforms/train array; object-level collection and count update.

patterns.working_title: Compute a result from a stated rule or table
patterns.boundary: Scoring, probabilities, age, years, arithmetic or condition-based result; preserve stated assumptions.

patterns.working_title: Validate and repeat user input
patterns.boundary: Range/length/choice/type/availability conditions and termination; check digit has own tag.

patterns.working_title: Accept unused items or answers without replacement
patterns.boundary: Track selected positions or mark matched answers consumed; reject repeated acceptance. Preserve position-choice versus answer-matching variants.

patterns.working_title: Validate data using a check-digit algorithm
patterns.boundary: Compute the source-specified weighted arithmetic and comparison, including stated division/rounding or modulus. Never assume a standard modulo formula.

patterns.working_title: Compare strings character by character
patterns.boundary: Manual lexicographic comparison with source length/prefix assumptions.

patterns.working_title: Split delimited text into string tokens
patterns.boundary: Return separate string tokens with delimiters removed; manual-versus-built-in restriction is a variant. Typed parsing and dispatch into destination arrays uses STRING_ROUTE.

patterns.working_title: Parse typed string records and route values
patterns.boundary: Split compound records, interpret typed fields, select destination by a category field and store another field there; not merely tokenisation or a conditional Push of an already supplied character.

patterns.working_title: Encode consecutive runs
patterns.boundary: Digit/character followed by count; max-run and nonempty assumptions are variants.

patterns.working_title: Implement a supplied otherwise unnamed algorithm
patterns.boundary: Use only where no specific operation pattern fits; recursion/iteration, parameters and outputs explicit.

patterns.working_title: Transform between recursive and iterative forms
patterns.boundary: Preserve algorithm behavior; co-tag specific algorithm when relevant.

patterns.working_title: Compose existing calls and control program flow
patterns.boundary: Top-level or helper-function orchestration: call sequence, input-to-call plumbing, looped calls and simple result handling; invoked algorithms are context.

patterns.working_title: Output or return data in a specified format
patterns.boundary: Grid/array/object messages/concatenation without changing logical data structure.

patterns.working_title: Run prescribed tests and capture evidence
patterns.boundary: Required inputs/outputs/screenshots; algorithms under test are context, not newly implemented.
